handling_actions.abort_before_entry: halt immediately; do not submit any tx; write HALT_<reason>_CN.md; report operator; require new approval to retry
handling_actions.exit_immediately: skip any remaining Step 1+ actions; jump to Step 4 (decreaseLiquidity+collect+revoke); do not wait for hold_window
handling_actions.manual_intervention_required: halt; do not auto-exit; report operator; do not retry automatically; await explicit operator decision
handling_actions.do_not_retry_automatically: any failed tx or stop condition must NOT be auto-retried; retry requires new approval + new session_id

stop_conditions.condition: eth_chainId != 8453
stop_conditions.rationale: wrong network; any tx would burn gas on a non-Base chain

stop_conditions.condition: current wallet's pubkey-hash or nonce pattern differs from frozen wallet 0xb05b2872ace4564ff247555b6f7b097d31f3d835
stop_conditions.rationale: wallet was rotated or address was misconfigured

stop_conditions.condition: eth_getBalance(wallet) < 9.0e-5 ETH (~$0.18) OR < 1.5x expected total gas cost
stop_conditions.rationale: insufficient gas for the full round-trip

stop_conditions.condition: USDC.balanceOf(wallet) < (chosen_notional + 2) USDC
stop_conditions.rationale: insufficient principal + slippage buffer

stop_conditions.condition: WETH.balanceOf(wallet) < 0 (impossible) OR for chosen notional != 0 WETH case, WETH.balance < required
stop_conditions.rationale: primary 10U/20U paths require 0 WETH; this stop is a guard against misconfiguration

stop_conditions.condition: USDC.allowance(wallet, NPM) > 50_000_000 OR WETH.allowance(wallet, NPM) > 1e24 (suspicious dust from prior run / not properly revoked)
stop_conditions.rationale: an over-large leftover allowance may be from a different protocol or a prior un-revoked approval; do not silently override

stop_conditions.condition: QuoterV2 returns out_amount < 0.95 * expected_out for either direction
stop_conditions.rationale: current pool depth insufficient for chosen notional at acceptable slippage

stop_conditions.condition: abs(current_tick - (-200443)) > 200 (i.e. current_tick outside the new half-range envelope around the original center)
stop_conditions.rationale: drift > half-range means a 15m hold will almost certainly be out-of-range; need fresh tick range approval

stop_conditions.condition: pool.liquidity() < 1e15 OR < 0.1 * frozen_value (≈ 1e17)
stop_conditions.rationale: liquidity drop > 10x implies pool state anomaly

stop_conditions.condition: QuoterV2.quoteExactInputSingle reverts OR returns 0 for either direction
stop_conditions.rationale: no spot reference = no safe entry

stop_conditions.condition: eth_estimateGas(mint_call) > 360,000 OR estimateGas reverts
stop_conditions.rationale: anomalous gas suggests pool state changed or estimate gas node misreporting

stop_conditions.condition: approve tx stays pending > 5 min OR is replaced in mempool unexpectedly OR nonce gap detected
stop_conditions.rationale: mempool anomalies require operator decision; do not cancel and retry automatically

stop_conditions.condition: approve tx reverts on chain
stop_conditions.rationale: approve must succeed for any later step; do not retry with different amount (would mean a logic error)

stop_conditions.condition: mint tx stays pending > 5 min OR is replaced unexpectedly OR nonce gap detected
stop_conditions.rationale: a stuck mint with already-set USDC allowance is dangerous; operator decision required

stop_conditions.condition: mint tx reverts on chain (e.g. INSUFFICIENT_LIQUIDITY, INVALID_TICK_RANGE, POOL_NOT_FOUND)
stop_conditions.rationale: if mint fails, no position exists; no exit needed; record failure and stop

stop_conditions.condition: ERC721 Transfer event not found in mint tx receipt, OR NPM.positions(tokenId) returns liquidity=0 and tokensOwed=0 right after mint
stop_conditions.rationale: we cannot trace the position; this is a data-integrity problem; operator must investigate

stop_conditions.condition: mark-to-market drawdown vs entry > 20% of entry principal (i.e. < $8 for 10U probe; < $16 for 20U)
stop_conditions.rationale: drawdown > 20% exceeds the probe's risk envelope; do not wait for hold to complete

stop_conditions.condition: current_tick moves outside [tickLower, tickUpper] during hold and stays out for > 2 consecutive minutes
stop_conditions.rationale: out-of-range LP earns 0 fees; extending hold only compounds IL

stop_conditions.condition: QuoterV2.quoteExactInputSingle for the close-direction reverts or returns 0 just before decreaseLiquidity
stop_conditions.rationale: we cannot pre-compute a safe amount1Min; proceeding with amount1Min=0 risks sandwich attacks but exiting is also urgent

stop_conditions.condition: NPM.collect reverts
stop_conditions.rationale: fees are stuck; need operator decision (likely retry collect with same args; do not auto-retry)

stop_conditions.condition: any RPC call times out > 3 times in a row OR returns 5xx OR rate-limits consistently
stop_conditions.rationale: we cannot safely track state; do not make irreversible moves (approve/mint/decrease) under RPC instability

stop_conditions.condition: any exception not covered by the above conditions
stop_conditions.rationale: unknown errors must not be auto-handled; operator reviews
